title: holiday — monkey

sentences.sentence: The school holidays start tomorrow.
sentences.translation: 学校假期从明天开始。

sentences.sentence: He is pale, dark, and authoritative, with the gravitas you might expect of a Nobel prize winner.
sentences.translation: 他面色苍白、皮肤呈深色、有权威性，带着你可能期待的一位诺贝尔奖得主的那种庄严。

phrases.translation: 脆性破坏；脆性疲劳；脆性失败

sentences.sentence: In systems such as this we also often find that there are either no tests around this configuration code, or the tests that do exist are brittle and/or not realistic.
sentences.translation: 在这样的系统中，我们经常会发现对于这些配置代码没有进行测试，或者尽管存在测试，但它很脆弱且/或不切实际。

sentences.sentence: But while our screens are brittle, theirs is flexible––at what they say is one tenth the price.
sentences.translation: 但我们的屏幕都很脆弱，他们的却很柔软，而且价钱是我们的十分之一。

sentences.sentence: a machine for dispensing cash
sentences.translation: 取款机

sentences.sentence: The meat was so burnt that it was inedible.
sentences.translation: 肉烧得那么焦，不能吃了。

sentences.sentence: He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun.
sentences.translation: 他把她诱骗到家里，然后用父亲的枪把她打死。

sentences.sentence: As I looked swiftly away, it seemed to me that his glance held some kind of unmet expectation.
sentences.translation: 我很快地看向别处，对我来说他的目光里似乎带着某种得不到满足的渴望。

sentences.sentence: I believe that anywhere within a metre or so of daily maximum sea level would be swiftly eroded.
sentences.translation: 我认为在那些水深达到一米或是每天水位最高到一米的地方，海平面会被很快侵蚀。

sentences.sentence: Next time such an apology is likely to happen swiftly and immediately as women candidates set up media watchdog brigades to force the media to give them more equal treatment.
sentences.translation: 下一次这类道歉可能会很快地和迅速地得到处理因为女性候选人建立了媒体监察队来强迫媒体给她们一个更公平的对待。

sentences.sentence: Doctors say it’s too risky to try and operate.
sentences.translation: 医生说动手术风险太大。

sentences.sentence: Buying a secondhand car is a risky business .
sentences.translation: 买二手汽车是有风险的。

sentences.sentence: Beverly: Why else would you grow a pancreas in a teenaged gibbon?
sentences.translation: 要不然在年轻长臂猿体内培育人类胰腺干什么?

sentences.sentence: The Christian Coalition should adopt as their mascot the white-handed gibbon, with his perfect nuclear family of one loyal  gibbette and several gibblets.
sentences.translation: 其中白交长臂猿拥有最忠实和完美的小家庭，基督教联盟完全可以将其作为最纯洁的吉祥物。

sentences.sentence: a raccoon coat
sentences.translation: 浣熊皮大衣

sentences.sentence: On our website you can peep our video interview with R&B’s newest supergroup.
sentences.translation: 在我们的网站可以观看到节奏布鲁斯最新超级组合的采访录像。

sentences.sentence: It distracts us, and takes our arousal back to the starting blocks.
sentences.translation: 它分散我们的注意力，使我们的觉醒又回到了起点。

sentences.sentence: I asked as a primitive sense of arousal kicked in at the base of my medulla.
sentences.translation: 真够神的，”我回答说，脑子里似乎有一种原始的欲望在觉醒，在升腾。

sentences.sentence: All drugs of abuse stimulate the release of the neurotransmitter dopamine.
sentences.translation: 所有的药物滥用都刺激了神经递质多巴胺的释放。

sentences.sentence: Dopamine is a neurotransmitter critical to the experience of pleasure and desire, and sends a signal to the brain: Pay attention, this is important.
sentences.translation: 多巴胺是一种神经递质，对于人感受快乐和欲望至关重要，而且会向大脑发送这样一个信号：注意了，这很重要。

sentences.sentence: The nucleus accumbens is associated with other kinds of longing — for alcohol and drugs — and is more dense in the neurotransmitter dopamine than in serotonin.
sentences.translation: 阿肯柏氏核还与其他种类的渴望（比如嗜酒，嗑药）相联系---而且在血清素里神经传递素多巴胺的浓度更高。

sentences.sentence: Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
sentences.translation: 两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

phrases.translation: 四轮滑冰鞋；轮式溜冰鞋

sentences.sentence: Other common forms of synecdoche include two concentric circles or triangles (used as eyes in horse and bison paintings), ibex horns and the hump of a mammoth.
sentences.translation: 其他普通的提喻形式包括两个同心圆或者三角形（在壁画上马和犀牛的眼睛里也有使用），野生山羊的羊角和长毛象弓起的背部。

sentences.translation: 那只猴子到处乱窜。

sentences.translation: 这只猴子囫囵吞下食物。

sentences.sentence: The monkey had deflowered an entire section of the garden.
sentences.translation: 这只猴子把花园中一整块地方的花都糟蹋了。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 256 单元

holiday
音标：英 /'hɒlɪdeɪ; -dɪ/  美 /'hɑləde/
n. 假日
短语：on holiday — 在度假；在休假中
短语：summer holiday — 暑假
短语：public holiday — 公休假日；国定假日
短语：happy holiday — 快乐的节日；愉快的假期
短语：winter holiday — 寒假
短语：national holiday — n. 国定假日
短语：holiday inn — n. 假日酒店；假日旅馆
短语：holiday resort — 度假胜地
短语：go on holiday — 去度假；正在休假
短语：have a holiday — 休假， 放假；度假；有一个假期
短语：holiday economy — 假日经济（在节假日由于人们普遍参与各项休闲娱乐活动而引发的消费热潮）
短语：official holiday — 法定假期
短语：legal holiday — [美]法定假日
短语：holiday time — 假期；假日时光
短语：take a holiday — v. 度假；休假
短语：easter holiday — 复活节假期
短语：holiday gift — 节日礼物
短语：bank holiday — 银行休假日
短语：holiday greetings — 节日问候（holiday greeting的复数）
短语：statutory holiday — n. 法定假日
例句：The school holidays start tomorrow.
学校假期从明天开始。

gravitas
音标：英 /'grævɪtæs; -tɑːs/  美 /'ɡrævitæs/
n. 庄严(举止)
例句：He is pale, dark, and authoritative, with the gravitas you might expect of a Nobel prize winner.
他面色苍白、皮肤呈深色、有权威性，带着你可能期待的一位诺贝尔奖得主的那种庄严。

foresightedness
n. 先见之明

prerecord
音标：英 /,priː'rɪ'kɔːd/  美 /,prirɪ'kɔrd/
v. 事先录音
例句：a prerecorded interview
事先录制的采访

brittle
音标：英 /'brɪt(ə)l/  美 /'brɪtl/
adj. 易碎的, 脆弱的
短语：brittle fracture — 脆性破坏
短语：brittle material — 脆性物料
短语：brittle failure — 脆性破坏；脆性疲劳；脆性失败
例句：In systems such as this we also often find that there are either no tests around this configuration code, or the tests that do exist are brittle and/or not realistic.
在这样的系统中，我们经常会发现对于这些配置代码没有进行测试，或者尽管存在测试，但它很脆弱且/或不切实际。
例句：But while our screens are brittle, theirs is flexible––at what they say is one tenth the price.
但我们的屏幕都很脆弱，他们的却很柔软，而且价钱是我们的十分之一。

dispense
音标：英 /dɪ'spens/  美 /dɪ'spɛns/
v. 分发, 分配
短语：dispense with — 无需；免除；省掉
例句：a machine for dispensing cash
取款机

inedible
音标：英 /ɪn'edɪb(ə)l/  美 /ɪn'ɛdəbl/
adj. 不能吃的，不宜食用的
例句：The meat was so burnt that it was inedible.
肉烧得那么焦，不能吃了。

lure
音标：英 /l(j)ʊə/  美 /lʊr/
v. 引诱
例句：He lured her to his home and shot her with his father's gun.
他把她诱骗到家里，然后用父亲的枪把她打死。

swiftly
音标：英 /'swiftli/  美 /'swɪftli/
adv. 很快地, 即刻
例句：As I looked swiftly away, it seemed to me that his glance held some kind of unmet expectation.
我很快地看向别处，对我来说他的目光里似乎带着某种得不到满足的渴望。
例句：I believe that anywhere within a metre or so of daily maximum sea level would be swiftly eroded.
我认为在那些水深达到一米或是每天水位最高到一米的地方，海平面会被很快侵蚀。
例句：Next time such an apology is likely to happen swiftly and immediately as women candidates set up media watchdog brigades to force the media to give them more equal treatment.
下一次这类道歉可能会很快地和迅速地得到处理因为女性候选人建立了媒体监察队来强迫媒体给她们一个更公平的对待。

risky
音标：英 /'rɪskɪ/  美 /'rɪski/
adj. 危险的
例句：Doctors say it’s too risky to try and operate.
医生说动手术风险太大。
例句：Buying a secondhand car is a risky business .
买二手汽车是有风险的。

gibbon
音标：英 /'gɪb(ə)n/  美 /'ɡɪbən/
n. 长臂猿
例句：Beverly: Why else would you grow a pancreas in a teenaged gibbon?
要不然在年轻长臂猿体内培育人类胰腺干什么?
例句：The Christian Coalition should adopt as their mascot the white-handed gibbon, with his perfect nuclear family of one loyal  gibbette and several gibblets.
其中白交长臂猿拥有最忠实和完美的小家庭，基督教联盟完全可以将其作为最纯洁的吉祥物。

raccoon
音标：英 /rə'kuːn/  美 /ræ'kun/
n. <美>[动]浣熊
例句：a raccoon coat
浣熊皮大衣

peep
音标：英 /piːp/  美 /pip/
n&vi. 窥视, 偷看
短语：peep at — 偷看，偷窥
例句：On our website you can peep our video interview with R&B’s newest supergroup.
在我们的网站可以观看到节奏布鲁斯最新超级组合的采访录像。

arousal
音标：英 /ə'raʊzl/  美 /ə'raʊzl/
n. 觉醒, 激励
例句：It distracts us, and takes our arousal back to the starting blocks.
它分散我们的注意力，使我们的觉醒又回到了起点。
例句：I asked as a primitive sense of arousal kicked in at the base of my medulla.
真够神的，”我回答说，脑子里似乎有一种原始的欲望在觉醒，在升腾。

neurotransmitter
音标：英 /,njʊərəʊtrænz'mɪtə/  美 /'nʊrotrænzmɪtɚ/
n. [生化]神经传递素
例句：All drugs of abuse stimulate the release of the neurotransmitter dopamine.
所有的药物滥用都刺激了神经递质多巴胺的释放。
例句：Dopamine is a neurotransmitter critical to the experience of pleasure and desire, and sends a signal to the brain: Pay attention, this is important.
多巴胺是一种神经递质，对于人感受快乐和欲望至关重要，而且会向大脑发送这样一个信号：注意了，这很重要。
例句：The nucleus accumbens is associated with other kinds of longing — for alcohol and drugs — and is more dense in the neurotransmitter dopamine than in serotonin.
阿肯柏氏核还与其他种类的渴望（比如嗜酒，嗑药）相联系---而且在血清素里神经传递素多巴胺的浓度更高。

avalanche
音标：英 /'ævəlɑːnʃ/  美 /'ævəlæntʃ/
n. 雪崩
短语：avalanche photodiode — 雪崩光电二极管
例句：Two skiers were killed in the avalanche.
两名滑雪者在雪崩中丧生。

skyrocket
音标：英 /'skaɪrɒkɪt/  美 /'skaɪ'rɑkɪt/
n. 冲天火箭（烟火）

skate
音标：英 /skeɪt/  美 /sket/
n. 冰鞋 vi溜冰
短语：ice skate — 溜冰鞋；溜冰
短语：roller skate — 四轮滑冰鞋；轮式溜冰鞋

ibex
音标：英 /'aɪbeks/  美 /'aɪbɛks/
n. 野生山羊
例句：Other common forms of synecdoche include two concentric circles or triangles (used as eyes in horse and bison paintings), ibex horns and the hump of a mammoth.
其他普通的提喻形式包括两个同心圆或者三角形（在壁画上马和犀牛的眼睛里也有使用），野生山羊的羊角和长毛象弓起的背部。

monkey
音标：英 /'mʌŋkɪ/  美 /'mʌŋki/
n. 猴子
短语：monkey business — 胡闹，骗人的把戏；欺骗；恶作剧
短语：monkey king — 美猴王，孙悟空
短语：golden monkey — 金丝猴
短语：monkey tricks — 猴子把戏；耍猴戏；[口]恶作剧
短语：get the monkey off — [美俚]戒除吸毒恶习
短语：monkey wrench — n. 活动扳手；螺旋钳
短语：rhesus monkey — 猕猴
短语：monkey with — 瞎弄；乱搞
短语：monkey bars — （美）供儿童攀爬游戏的猴架；（英）健身房的攀架
短语：monkey island — 标准罗经平台；罗经甲板
短语：proboscis monkey — n. [动]长鼻猴
例句：The monkey is beating up and down.
那只猴子到处乱窜。
例句：The monkey engulfed the food whole.
这只猴子囫囵吞下食物。
例句：The monkey had deflowered an entire section of the garden.
这只猴子把花园中一整块地方的花都糟蹋了。
